review.clone3: Unmodified upstream behavior: ENOSYS (errno 38) without CAP_SYS_ADMIN, allowing libc fallback to clone. The conditional upstream CAP_SYS_ADMIN rule is not a capability grant; deployment and smoke must not add that capability.
review.activationGate: Try the default Docker seccomp policy first. Keep this candidate inactive if default sandboxed launch works. Otherwise validate this JSON with the intended Docker/libseccomp version and run the final image as its non-root user with --network none and this policy. scripts/smoke-browser.mjs must pass before activation; no widening fallback is authorized.
